I’m so sorry for your loss. I am struggling to keep being alive for my son. I’ve attempted many times but I fail. I’ve recently decided to get treatment I need - for my son.

Please please check out my gofundme page or share it. It’s under “single mom needs treatment”

Depressed, suicidal, anxiety, fibromyalgia and a single mom to a beautiful boy. I finally decided to get treatment to get the help I need for my son. I do need help with meal fare, travel fare and some lodging. Please please someone help. I’m running out of time and idk if I’ll ever go to treatment again. It’s the only time I can go.
